rows.grounds: Locative of śūnya used for place; refers to an empty house/site in this rite context.
Locative of geha meaning house; paired with śūnye to specify the empty house.
Absolutive of sam-ānī (to bring together/to bring); fused form kept as given.
Conjunction linking the action to what follows.
Compound arghya + ādika (etc.); accusative neuter singular object referring to arghya and related items.
Optative/precative form of viśudh (to purify), 3rd person singular active.
